rows.label: PRESENT
rows.clue: The period of time that is happening now

rows.label: OVERFLOW
rows.clue: Flow or run over (a limit or brim)

rows.label: HEART URCHIN
rows.clue: Sea urchin having a heart-shaped body in a rigid spiny shell

rows.label: LIVING WAGE
rows.clue: A wage sufficient for a worker and family to subsist comfortably

rows.label: ORDER BOOK
rows.clue: A printed copy of the order of the day

rows.label: AUGURY
rows.clue: An event that is experienced as indicating important things to come

rows.label: STOCK CAR
rows.clue: A car kept in dealers' stock for regular sales

rows.label: BLUE CHEESE
rows.clue: Cheese containing a blue mold

rows.label: MEMBERSHIP
rows.clue: The body of members of an organization or group

rows.label: ZERO TOLERANCE
rows.clue: Extreme intolerance of antisocial behavior (usually by an uncompromising application of the law)

rows.label: DOESKIN
rows.clue: Soft leather from deerskin or lambskin

rows.label: SPECTRUM
rows.clue: An ordered array of the components of an emission or wave

rows.label: QUASAR
rows.clue: A starlike object that may send out radio waves and other forms of energy

rows.label: MONETARY UNIT
rows.clue: A unit of money

rows.label: SUBDIVISION
rows.clue: An area composed of subdivided lots

rows.label: WALNUT TREE
rows.clue: Any of various trees of the genus Juglans

rows.label: PRECONCEIVED
rows.clue: (of an idea or opinion) formed beforehand

rows.label: GUEST NIGHT
rows.clue: An evening when members of a club or college can bring their friends as guests

rows.label: REMEMBER
rows.clue: Recall knowledge from memory

rows.label: POLICE DOG
rows.clue: Any dog trained to assist police especially in tracking

rows.label: PERSONAL LOAN
rows.clue: A loan that establishes consumer credit that is granted for personal use

rows.label: STORYBOOK
rows.clue: A book containing a collection of stories (usually for children)

rows.label: ADVANCE
rows.clue: A movement forward

rows.label: FOODSTUFF
rows.clue: (usually plural) consumer goods sold by a grocer

rows.label: CATFISH
rows.clue: Flesh of scaleless food fish of the southern United States

rows.label: GOVERNED
rows.clue: The body of people who are citizens of a particular government

rows.label: EXTREMISM
rows.clue: Any political theory favoring immoderate uncompromising policies

rows.label: MINERAL OIL
rows.clue: A distillate of petroleum (especially one used medicinally as a laxative or stool softener)

rows.label: RADIANT ENERGY
rows.clue: Energy that is transmitted in the form of (electromagnetic) radiation

rows.label: METEORITE
rows.clue: Stony or metallic object that is the remains of a meteoroid that has reached the earth's surface

rows.label: ENOUGH
rows.clue: An adequate quantity

rows.label: FLIGHT LINE
rows.clue: Place where airplanes are parked and the maintenance hangars (but not the runways or taxiways)

rows.label: LADY PALM
rows.clue: Any of several small palms of the genus Rhapis

rows.label: FINITE
rows.clue: Bounded or limited in magnitude or spatial or temporal extent

rows.label: LUNAR CALENDAR
rows.clue: A calendar based on lunar cycles

rows.label: ROYAL CASINO
rows.clue: A form of casino in which face cards have extra point values

rows.label: WILD DOG
rows.clue: Any of various undomesticated mammals of the family Canidae that are thought to resemble domestic dogs as distinguished from jackals or wolves

rows.label: RECEIVABLES
rows.clue: Money that you currently expect to receive from notes or accounts

rows.label: SIDEBAR
rows.clue: (law) a courtroom conference between the lawyers and the judge that is held out of the jury's hearing

rows.label: APPROACHING
rows.clue: The event of one object coming closer to another

rows.label: THREAD
rows.clue: A fine cord of twisted fibers (of cotton or silk or wool or nylon etc.) used in sewing and weaving

rows.label: DRIPPINGS
rows.clue: Fat that exudes from meat and drips off while it is being roasted or fried

rows.label: FOSTER HOME
rows.clue: A household in which an orphaned or delinquent child is placed (usually by a social-service agency)

rows.label: TYPIFICATION
rows.clue: A representational or typifying form or model

rows.label: PTOMAINE
rows.clue: Any of various amines (such as putrescine or cadaverine) formed by the action of putrefactive bacteria

rows.label: FIELD LINE
rows.clue: An imaginary line in a field of force

rows.label: AIR BUBBLE
rows.clue: A bubble of air

rows.label: THIRTY
rows.clue: The cardinal number that is the product of ten and three

rows.label: ISOBAR
rows.clue: (meteorology)an isogram connecting points having equal barometric pressure at a given time

rows.label: PUDDING BERRY
rows.clue: Creeping perennial herb distinguished by red berries and clustered leaf whorls at the tips of shoots

rows.label: ILLEGAL
rows.clue: Prohibited by law or by official or accepted rules

rows.label: MILLISECOND
rows.clue: One thousandth (10^-3) of a second

rows.label: DRIP CULTURE
rows.clue: A hydroponic method of growing plants by allowing nutrient solutions to drip slowly onto an inert medium in which the plants are growing

rows.label: MOORHEN
rows.clue: Black gallinule that inhabits ponds and lakes

rows.label: ALLOWANCE
rows.clue: An amount allowed or granted (as during a given period)

rows.label: CRITICISM
rows.clue: Disapproval expressed by pointing out faults or shortcomings

rows.label: WHITE NOISE
rows.clue: A noise produced by a stimulus containing all of the audible frequencies of vibration

rows.label: NIGHT BELL
rows.clue: A doorbell to be used at night

rows.label: SHORTCAKE
rows.clue: Very short biscuit dough baked as individual biscuits or a round loaf

rows.label: STAFF OFFICE
rows.clue: The department responsible for hiring and training and placing employees and for setting policies for personnel management

rows.label: PRAGMATICS
rows.clue: The study of language use

rows.label: DESERT SOIL
rows.clue: A type of soil that develops in arid climates

rows.label: FOCAL POINT
rows.clue: A point of convergence of light (or other radiation) or a point from which it diverges

rows.label: CASCADE
rows.clue: A small waterfall or series of small waterfalls
